reference.description: re-computes DispEn and RDEn with NeuroKit2 entropy_dispersion across (c, dimension, delay) settings; reports DispEn and RDEn at the default, the bit-exact NeuroKit2 agreement for both, the number of distinct dispersion patterns observed out of c^m, and that DispEn lies below the 1/ln(2) ceiling
